meta.name: English Premier League
meta.notice: Fixtures and results come from a free multi-source pipeline. Attack and defense ratings are fitted from 1,557 completed matches using a Bayesian state-space Poisson model. Polymarket and Kalshi season-winner, exact 1X2, and regulation-time total-goals prices are displayed as independent comparisons when exact markets are available. Each source is normalized within its event for like-for-like comparison; a simple cross-market consensus is also shown. None of these prices are used as model inputs.

backtest.method: time-ordered holdout; latest matches and current preseason seeds excluded before fitting
backtest.limitations: This is a lightweight match-outcome holdout, not a complete season-title calibration study. Current preseason seeds and Polymarket data are excluded. It is intended to catch large regressions during automated rebuilds.

match_markets.discovery_method: status-agnostic events plus markets fallback within the configured Kalshi series

total_goals.price_method: Over probability from Yes bid/ask midpoint when usable; otherwise latest trade

sanity_checks.note: Sanity checks never feed Kalshi prices into the Bayesian model.

market_consensus.method: Equal-weight mean of available normalized estimates; no market data enters the Bayesian model

market_comparison.season_winner_prices: The pipeline retrieves one exact season-winner event from each exchange. Polymarket contract prices and Kalshi bid/ask midpoint estimates are normalized within their own event when coverage is sufficient.
market_comparison.match_prices: A match comparison is published only for a date-verified full-match home/draw/away event that matches both clubs and contains all three outcomes.
market_comparison.total_goals_prices: Regulation-time total-goals comparisons use date/team-verified contest totals only. Team totals and other derivative markets are rejected.
market_comparison.kalshi_price_method: Kalshi uses the midpoint of the best Yes bid and ask when the spread is usable; otherwise the latest trade is used. The three match outcomes are then normalized to 100%.
market_comparison.consensus: Market consensus is the equal-weight mean of the available normalized Polymarket and Kalshi estimates. It is diagnostic only.
market_comparison.edge_definition: Bayesian probability minus the selected external-market probability

preseason_calibration.last_fitted_state: The fitted time axis ends at the last completed match.
